```{r setup, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(quarto)
library(data.table)

source("20_functions/source_dir.R")
source_dir("20_functions")

tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
do_print <- interactive()
```


## Compile Primary-Publication quarto book

Generate `.qmd` chapter files and YML profile file:
```{r pp_tlf_book}
Book <- "pp"
Bookdir <- paste0("60_tlf_book_", Book)
if(dir.exists(Bookdir)) unlink(Bookdir, recursive = TRUE)
mk_book_qmds(book    = Book, 
             tlf_reg = tlf_reg,
             verbose = do_print)

mk_book_yml(book     = Book, 
            subtitle = "Primary Publication",
            tlf_reg  = tlf_reg)

# Compile the quarto-book:
quarto_render(input = "40_tlf_source", output_format = "html", profile = Book)
```

## Compile Full quarto book

Generate `.qmd` chapter files and YML profile file:
```{r full_tlf_book}
Book <- "all"
Bookdir <- paste0("60_tlf_book_", Book)
if(dir.exists(Bookdir)) unlink(Bookdir, recursive = TRUE)
mk_book_qmds(book    = Book, 
            tlf_reg  = tlf_reg,
             verbose = do_print)

mk_book_yml(book     = Book, 
            subtitle = "-Complete Book",
            tlf_reg  = tlf_reg)

# Compile the quarto-book:
quarto_render(input = "40_tlf_source", output_format = "html", profile = Book)
# quarto_render(input = "40_tlf_source", output_format = "pdf", profile = Book)
```
